claims.statement: For the specified two-orbit tree family T_m, every eligible lower-region rank at each 1<=m<=80 has both original leaf orbits favorable and has a strictly negative complete selected sum, as verified by independent graph-derived recurrence with corrected claw selector values.
claims.scope: Exact finite coefficient computation on T_m for m=1,...,80 and every p satisfying x(T_m)+2<=p<=alpha(T_m) and 3p<2alpha(T_m)+1. No conclusion for m>80 or trees outside this family.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: independent edge-graph recurrence checks all 1,749 eligible rows and literal subsets check the m=3 tree and all leaf-deletion/H/R graphs. The source replay omits a factor (1+2z) in its claw deletion polynomial, making all reported claw selector differences numerically incorrect; corrected selector booleans, q-terms, and complete sums nevertheless agree on every eligible row.

claims.statement: The exact derivative identity for the all-leaf marked polynomial does not establish the selected aggregate sign for all eligible m and p; the all-parameter T_m sign and both universal orbit-selector claims remain unresolved.
claims.scope: The infinite specified T_m family under the ordinary-tree lower-region hypotheses; no universal conclusion is established.
claims.reason: retained: the derivative formula is an algebraic identity, and the fixed selector equals the all-leaf marked polynomial only after both strict selector tests are proved. The bounded checks do not supply those tests or a uniform coefficient comparison for all m,p.

limitations: The verified computation is limited to m=1,...,80 in the specified family and does not census ordinary trees.

The sealed producer replay omits the factor (1+2z) in the claw deletion polynomial; its claw selector differences are numerically wrong on every eligible row, although corrected selector signs and full sums were independently verified.
No all-parameter selector proof, all-parameter family sign proof, or proof of the primary ordinary-tree aggregate is supplied.
No external literature or Lean verification was used.
